What is a bot session?

How can I buy additional bot sessions?

How does the 21-day trial work?

What is a bot session?

A bot session is any unique interaction between an end-user and a bot. On chat, all end-users to bot interactions in a day are counted as 1 bot session and lasts for a maximum of 24 hours. # Freshworks CRM Review and Pricing ## Freshsales Features From AI-powered lead scoring and forecasting to workflow automation and team performance tracking, the software gives sales managers plenty of visibility into their pipeline while helping reps stay focused on selling. ### Built-in Phone Functionality and Automation - **IVR and intelligent call routing:** Freshsales includes [interactive voice response (IVR)](https://www.business.com/articles/business-phone-ivr/) tools that can automatically greet callers and route them to the appropriate team, queue, extension or voicemail. We appreciate how these tools help ensure customers reach the right person while reducing the burden on sales and support teams. - **Built-in productivity tools:** The caller widget includes handy features like call notes and voicemail drop, so reps can take notes as they talk and leave a prerecorded message when someone doesn’t answer. Higher-tier plans also offer Power Dialer [auto-dialer](https://www.business.com/articles/auto-dialer/) functionality for reps who need to make their way through a long list of calls. ## Freshsales Pricing Freshsales offers three paid CRM plans ranging from $9 to $59 per user per month when billed annually. Here’s a look at what each plan includes. | Plan | Pricing (Annual Billing) | Key Features | |-|-|-| | Growth | $9/user/month | - Contact management
- Kanban views
- Contact lifecycle stages
- Built-in email, chat and phone
- Email templates
- Custom fields
- Basic workflows | | Pro | $39/user/month | Everything in Growth plus:
- Contact scoring
- Deal insights
- Territory management
- Sales sequences
- Custom sales activities | | Enterprise | $59/user/month | Everything in Pro, plus: 
- Forecasting insights
- Field-level permissions
- Custom modules
- Sandbox testing
- Audit logs | - **Monthly billing costs more:** The prices above reflect annual billing. Businesses that prefer month-to-month flexibility can also pay monthly, although the per-user cost is roughly 20 percent higher. - **A free trial is available:** Freshsales offers a 21-day free trial that includes Enterprise-level features (no credit card required). We like that you can explore the platform without providing payment information upfront. - **Some popular features cost extra:** Branded Documents, Freshworks’ configure-price-quote (CPQ) and proposal-generation tool, is available as an add-on for $19 per user per month. Freddy AI Agent is also sold separately and starts at $49 per 100 sessions. These costs can add up quickly for larger teams or businesses planning to rely heavily on AI-powered customer interactions. - **Marketing add-ons can increase your overall costs:** Freshsales Suite includes 500 marketing contacts per plan, with additional contacts available starting at $100 per 5,000 contacts per month. Conversion rate optimization tools are also sold separately, so marketing-heavy organizations may end up paying more than the base subscription price. ## Limitations - **Advanced features require higher-tier plans:** Freshsales’ $9-per-user Growth plan covers the basics, but many of the platform’s most valuable sales tools — including contact scoring, deal insights, sales sequences, territory management and forecasting capabilities — require a Pro or Enterprise subscription. Businesses should review the feature breakdown carefully to ensure the plan they choose includes the functionality they need. ## Freshsales FAQs ### Is Freshsales free? Open accordion No. The entry-level Growth plan starts at $9 per user per month when billed annually. ## Bottom Line - Sales managers who want strong automation, reporting and AI-powered sales insights. - Sales teams that regularly communicate with customers via phone, chat, SMS, email and social media. - Businesses that want an affordable CRM today and the option to expand into marketing automation with Freshsales Suite later.

Freshsales CRM is our pick for sales managers thanks to its AI-powered insights, forecasting tools and sales automation features. It's a great fit for leaders who need visibility into team performance, deal progress and pipeline health.

Thumbs Up Pros

- AI-powered insights, lead scoring and deal recommendations help sales managers prioritize opportunities and identify bottlenecks.
- Robust automation tools reduce administrative work and help teams follow a consistent sales process.
- Customizable dashboards, forecasting tools and pipeline views give managers strong visibility into team performance and deal progress.

Thumbs Down Cons

- Important features such as territory management, deal insights and forecasting are reserved for higher-tier plans.
- New users may face a learning curve due to the platform's extensive customization and automation options.
- Freddy AI usage is subject to session limits, with additional AI sessions available as a paid add-on.

Sales managers have a lot to juggle, from monitoring team performance to keeping deals moving through the pipeline. Freshsales helps simplify those responsibilities with AI-powered insights, sales automation and forecasting tools that make it easier to spot opportunities, identify bottlenecks and stay on top of revenue goals. The result is a CRM that helps managers spend less time chasing updates and more time helping their teams [convert leads](https://www.business.com/articles/9-steps-to-lead-conversion-success/) and close deals.

### Freshsales CRM Editor's Rating:

9.3 / 10

## Why We Chose Freshsales as the Best CRM for Sales Managers

Freshsales includes all the core CRM capabilities businesses need to manage customer relationships, but what stood out during our evaluation was how easily sales managers can tailor the platform to fit their teams and processes. Managers can create custom workflows, automate lead assignments, build sales sequences and organize teams by territory, helping ensure opportunities are routed to the right people and followed up on consistently. Freshsales also supports multiple [sales pipelines](https://www.business.com/articles/crm-pipeline-management/), making it easier to manage different teams, products or [sales processes](https://www.business.com/articles/sales-process/) from a single platform.

We also like that Freshsales balances these management tools with practical AI features. Freddy AI can score contacts, surface promising opportunities and provide deal insights, helping teams focus their time where it matters most. Combined with customizable reports, sales goals and forecasting tools, Freshsales gives managers the flexibility to support their teams without adding unnecessary complexity.

Freshsales is a standalone CRM within the Freshworks ecosystem, which also includes marketing, customer service and IT management software. Businesses that want to combine CRM and marketing capabilities can opt for Freshsales Suite, which adds marketing automation, [customer journey](https://www.business.com/articles/small-business-customer-journey-map/) tools and additional communication channels while keeping customer data in a single system.

Bottom LineBottom line

Freshsales helps sales managers spend less time tracking down updates and more time coaching reps, prioritizing [sales leads](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-generate-more-sales-leads/) and moving deals forward.

![Freshsales gives sales managers a centralized view of customer information, deal activity and lead insights.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18102310%2Ffreshsales-manager.png&w=3840&q=80)Freshsales CRM contact record showing lead scores, lifecycle stages, deal information and activity tracking. Source: Freshworks

## Ease of Use

We were impressed by how much functionality Freshsales packs into a relatively intuitive interface. Despite offering advanced capabilities like [workflow automation](https://www.business.com/articles/workflow-automation/), sales sequences, AI-powered insights and forecasting tools, the platform never felt overly complicated during our evaluation. Sales managers can quickly access customer information, deal activity and team data, while reps can spend more time selling and less time switching between tools. Features like automation and Freddy AI are also built into the platform instead of feeling like separate products layered on top of the CRM.

Here are a few elements we felt added to the solution’s ease of use:

- **Centralized customer records:** Freshsales keeps contact information, deal activity, communication history, tasks and lead insights in a single view. We like that users can quickly understand the status of a customer relationship without jumping between multiple screens.
- **Activities dashboard:** The Activities dashboard displays appointments, pending tasks and other important information in one place. That makes it easier to prioritize daily work and stay on top of follow-up activities.
- **Customizable dashboards and reports:** Users can tailor dashboards to display the metrics most relevant to their role. We also appreciate that reports and dashboards are organized in a way that makes them easy to access and review.
- **Intuitive navigation:** Sidebar navigation provides quick access to contacts, deals, conversations, reports and automation tools. We found it easy to move between different areas of the CRM without digging through layers of menus.
- **Built-in AI assistance:** Freddy AI can provide contact scoring, deal insights and forecasting insights, depending on the plan, helping users surface important information directly within the CRM.
- **Marketplace integrations:** Freshsales supports integrations through the Freshworks Marketplace and allows businesses to import data from other CRM platforms and common file formats.

Freshsales is a great option for businesses adopting CRM software for the first time, but experienced [sales teams](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-build-a-sales-team/) will also appreciate how easy it is to customize the platform, import existing data and connect the tools they already use.

![Freshworks Marketplace displaying available integrations and productivity apps that can be added to Freshsales.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18102439%2Ffreshworks-marketplace-1024x609.png&w=2048&q=80)Freshsales integrates with a wide range of third-party business applications through the Freshworks Marketplace, making it easier to connect existing tools and workflows. Source: Freshworks

## Freshsales Features

Freshsales includes the core [CRM features](https://www.business.com/articles/features-to-look-for-in-crm/) you’d expect, but it’s the platform’s sales management capabilities that helped it stand out during our review. From AI-powered lead scoring and forecasting to workflow automation and team performance tracking, the software gives sales managers plenty of visibility into their pipeline while helping reps stay focused on selling.

Here’s a look at the features that impressed us most.

### Reporting and Analytics

Sales managers need clear visibility into team performance, pipeline health and revenue trends. We were impressed by Freshsales’ built-in [data analytics](https://www.business.com/articles/the-state-of-data-analytics/) platform, Freshworks Analytics, which makes it easy to turn sales data into actionable insights through customizable dashboards and reports.

Here are the reporting and analytics capabilities that stood out to us:

- **No-code dashboards and reports:** Freshworks Analytics uses drag-and-drop widgets, metrics and filters, allowing managers to create dashboards tailored to their team’s goals without relying on technical expertise. We liked that users can start with existing templates or build reports from scratch.
- **Curated Reports:** We were particularly impressed by the Curated Reports feature, which provides prebuilt dashboards and reports configured by Freshworks experts. These templates can help managers quickly track sales activity, forecasts, trends and other key performance indicators without spending time building reports themselves.
- **Team and territory visibility:** Freshsales supports reporting based on teams, territories and other performance metrics, giving managers a broader view of sales operations. This makes it easier to identify trends, compare performance and spot potential bottlenecks.
- **Report sharing and collaboration:** We appreciated how easy it is to share dashboards and reports with stakeholders, ensuring everyone has access to the same performance data and insights.
- **Sales and marketing reporting:** Businesses using Freshsales Suite, which combines Freshsales CRM with Freshworks’ marketing automation tools, can take reporting a step further by bringing sales and marketing data into a single platform. This unified view helps managers understand how marketing campaigns influence lead generation, engagement and sales outcomes.

![Freshworks Analytics dashboard displaying customizable filters, performance metrics, charts and reporting widgets.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18102553%2Ffreshworks-analytics-1024x642.png&w=2048&q=80)Freshworks Analytics helps sales managers build custom dashboards, filter performance data and monitor key business metrics from a single interface. Source: Freshworks

### Omnichannel Communication

Sales conversations don’t always happen through a single channel. Prospects may move between email, phone, text messages and chat throughout the buying process, making it easy for important details to get lost. We like that Freshsales keeps those interactions connected to the customer record, giving sales reps and managers a complete view of the relationship without jumping between multiple systems.

Here are the omnichannel communication features that impress us most:

- **Email and Team Inbox:** Freshsales includes two-way email sync, email templates and [bulk email](https://www.business.com/articles/email-blast/) capabilities, making it easy to manage outreach directly from the CRM. We were especially impressed by Team Inbox, which centralizes customer communications and helps managers ensure inquiries don’t go unanswered. Sales leaders can assign conversations to the most appropriate team member, [improve productivity](https://www.business.com/articles/five-ways-to-increase-business-productivity/) and accountability and maintain visibility into customer interactions across the organization.
- **Phone, SMS and messaging channels:** Freshsales supports communication through email, phone, SMS, web chat and popular messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, LINE and Google Business Messages. We like that all customer conversations can be connected to the contact record, creating a complete history of interactions regardless of where the conversation started.
- **Unified customer timelines:** One of Freshsales’ biggest strengths is its ability to consolidate communication history, activities and engagement data into a single customer view. Managers can quickly review emails, calls, messages, meetings and website activity without jumping between systems. This centralized view makes it easier to monitor pipeline activity, coach sales reps and identify opportunities to move deals forward.
- **Sales and marketing alignment:** Businesses using Freshsales Suite can connect customer communications with marketing activities for a more complete view of the customer journey. This helps sales and marketing teams work from the same information when evaluating engagement, qualifying opportunities and nurturing leads.

![Freshsales contact record showing customer communication history, activities and engagement across multiple channels.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18102833%2Ffreshsales-contacts-1024x609.png&w=2048&q=80)Freshsales stores emails, calls, messages and customer activity in a single contact timeline, helping sales teams manage conversations across channels. Source: Freshworks

FYIDid you know

Businesses using Freshsales Suite can track how prospects interact with [email marketing campaigns](https://www.business.com/articles/how-to-write-email-marketing-campaign/), including [email open rates](https://www.business.com/articles/email-open-rates/), clicks and other engagement metrics. These insights can help sales teams identify their most engaged sales leads and prioritize follow-up efforts.

### Built-in Phone Functionality and Automation

Sales teams spend a lot of time on the phone, so we like that Freshsales includes calling features directly within the CRM instead of relying entirely on third-party integrations. Reps can make and receive calls while viewing customer information, deal details and previous interactions, giving them the context they need to have more productive conversations. Managers also benefit from having call activity tied to CRM records, making it easier to monitor performance and coach team members.

Here are the most notable phone features we found:

- **Flexible phone setup:** Businesses can use their existing [business phone numbers](https://www.business.com/articles/need-a-business-phone-number-but-not-a-business-phone/) or purchase local, toll-free and vanity numbers through Freshworks. We like that companies can tailor their phone setup to fit their needs without adding a separate phone platform.
- **Call recording and transcription:** Freshsales supports call recording, allowing teams to document customer conversations and refer back to them when needed. We also liked the platform’s call transcription feature. Sales managers can review conversations, look for coaching opportunities and identify common customer concerns without having to listen to every call from beginning to end.
- **IVR and intelligent call routing:** Freshsales includes [interactive voice response (IVR)](https://www.business.com/articles/business-phone-ivr/) tools that can automatically greet callers and route them to the appropriate team, queue, extension or voicemail. We appreciate how these tools help ensure customers reach the right person while reducing the burden on sales and support teams.
- **Built-in productivity tools:** The caller widget includes handy features like call notes and voicemail drop, so reps can take notes as they talk and leave a prerecorded message when someone doesn’t answer. Higher-tier plans also offer Power Dialer [auto-dialer](https://www.business.com/articles/auto-dialer/) functionality for reps who need to make their way through a long list of calls.
- **Call reporting and performance tracking:** Freshsales provides reporting tools that help managers monitor call activity and evaluate team performance. Combined with call recordings and transcripts, these insights can help sales leaders identify trends, improve coaching efforts and support more consistent sales processes.

We also like that businesses can connect Freshsales to some of the [best business phone systems](https://www.business.com/categories/business-phone-systems/) they already use through marketplace integrations and APIs. This flexibility makes it easier for organizations to adopt the CRM without completely overhauling their existing communications infrastructure.

![Freshsales IVR call-routing interface showing automated phone menu and call flow configuration.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18103003%2Ffreshsales-call-routing.png&w=2048&q=80)Freshsales lets businesses create IVR menus and automated call-routing workflows directly within the CRM. Source: Freshworks

### CPQ and Quote Management

Creating accurate quotes can be time-consuming, especially for businesses that sell multiple products, subscription services or customized offerings. We liked Freshsales’ Branded Documents add-on, which allows teams to generate professional quotes, proposals and contracts directly from the CRM. Sales reps can pull customer information into documents automatically, helping reduce manual data entry and keep documents consistent across the organization.

Freshworks includes one Branded Documents license with all paid plans, allowing businesses to test the functionality before purchasing additional licenses for $19 per user per month. We also liked that the system supports the [subscription business model](https://www.business.com/articles/industries-that-take-full-advantage-of-the-subscription-business-model/), making it a strong fit for SaaS companies and other businesses with recurring revenue models.

TipBottom line

For businesses that [sell online](https://www.business.com/articles/5-options-for-setting-up-an-online-store/), Freshsales also integrates with platforms such as Shopify, helping synchronize customer information and giving sales and marketing teams a more complete view of customer activity.

![Freshsales CPQ interface for creating quotes, proposals and other customer-facing sales documents.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18103111%2Ffreshsales-cpq.jpg&w=2048&q=80)Freshsales offers a CPQ add-on that helps sales teams create quotes, proposals and contracts directly from the CRM. Source: Freshworks

### AI-Powered Assistant

We were impressed by Freddy AI, Freshsales’ artificial intelligence platform. Freddy helps sales teams prioritize leads, identify opportunities and spot deals that may need attention. It analyzes customer engagement, sales activity and pipeline data to pull insights that can help reps and managers make more informed decisions. We also liked that Freddy can assist with tasks like drafting emails and summarizing customer interactions, helping sales teams spend less time on administrative work.

Here are a few notable Freddy AI capabilities:

- **Predictive lead scoring:** With predictive [lead scoring](https://www.business.com/articles/lead-scoring/), Freddy evaluates lead activity and engagement to help sales teams focus on the prospects most likely to convert. We liked that the platform doesn’t just assign a score; it also explains the factors behind it, giving managers more visibility into why certain leads are prioritized.
- **Deal insights and risk alerts:** Freddy can flag deals that appear to have stalled and draw attention to opportunities that may need follow-up. We liked that managers can quickly see which deals may be losing momentum instead of digging through individual records to find potential problems.
- **AI-assisted content creation:** Freddy can generate draft emails and customer messages directly in Freshsales. While you’ll still want to review and personalize the content, it can save time when creating follow-ups, meeting invitations and other routine sales communications.
- **Recommended next steps:** By analyzing activity across the CRM, Freddy can suggest actions that may help move opportunities through the pipeline and keep deals progressing.

Freshworks now offers Freddy AI through several products, including Freddy Copilot, Freddy AI Insights and Freddy AI Agent. While many AI-powered capabilities are integrated into the Freshsales platform, some advanced features require higher-tier plans. The customer-facing Freddy AI Agent is also sold separately as a usage-based add-on starting at $49 per 100 sessions. Businesses planning to use AI-powered customer conversations at scale should factor those additional costs into their budgeting decisions.

![ Freshsales user prompting Freddy AI to draft a personalized sales email from within the CRM.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18103223%2Ffreshsales-ai.png&w=2048&q=80)Freddy AI can help sales teams draft emails and other customer communications directly within Freshsales. Source: Freshworks

### Workflow Automation

Automating routine tasks helps sales teams stay organized and ensures important follow-ups don’t fall through the cracks. We liked that Freshsales makes it easy to automate many of the day-to-day activities that can consume a sales rep’s time.

Here are a few automation capabilities sales managers will appreciate:

- **Workflow automation:** Freshsales can automatically send emails, update customer records, create tasks and move deals through pipeline stages based on predefined triggers. Managers can also configure notifications for sales reps, team leads and other stakeholders when important changes occur, helping everyone stay aligned without relying on manual updates.
- **Lead and follow-up management:** We liked that Freshsales can automatically surface leads that may need attention and trigger follow-up actions based on customer activity. This can help sales teams stay engaged with prospects instead of relying on manual reminders.
- **Battlecards:** Freshsales includes Battlecards, which give sales reps quick access to information they may need during customer conversations, such as competitive positioning, product details and responses to common objections. Managers can customize existing templates or create their own materials from scratch. The platform can also recommend relevant battlecards to reps based on the context of a deal or conversation.

![Freshsales workflow automation builder showing lead conditions, routing rules and automated actions.](https://www.business.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.business.com%2Fapp%2Fuploads%2F2019%2F06%2F18103325%2Ffreshsales-automation-1024x637.png&w=2048&q=80)Freshsales lets managers automate tasks, notifications, deal updates and other routine sales processes. Source: Freshworks

Did You Know?Did you know

Freshsales can recognize out-of-office email replies and automatically flag contacts as unavailable. This helps sales reps avoid wasting time on follow-ups and provides a reminder to send [reengagement emails](https://www.business.com/articles/re-engagement-email-marketing-strategy/) when the contact returns.

## Freshsales Pricing

Freshsales offers three paid CRM plans ranging from $9 to $59 per user per month when billed annually. Here’s a look at what each plan includes.

| Plan | Pricing (Annual Billing) | Key Features |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Growth | $9/user/month | - Contact management<br>- Kanban views<br>- Contact lifecycle stages<br>- Built-in email, chat and phone<br>- Email templates<br>- Custom fields<br>- Basic workflows |
| Pro | $39/user/month | Everything in Growth plus:<br>- Contact scoring<br>- Deal insights<br>- Territory management<br>- Sales sequences<br>- Custom sales activities |
| Enterprise | $59/user/month | Everything in Pro, plus: <br>- Forecasting insights<br>- Field-level permissions<br>- Custom modules<br>- Sandbox testing<br>- Audit logs |

Here are a few other pricing factors to keep in mind:

- **Monthly billing costs more:** The prices above reflect annual billing. Businesses that prefer month-to-month flexibility can also pay monthly, although the per-user cost is roughly 20 percent higher.
- **A free trial is available:** Freshsales offers a 21-day free trial that includes Enterprise-level features (no credit card required). We like that you can explore the platform without providing payment information upfront.
- **Some popular features cost extra:** Branded Documents, Freshworks’ configure-price-quote (CPQ) and proposal-generation tool, is available as an add-on for $19 per user per month. Freddy AI Agent is also sold separately and starts at $49 per 100 sessions. These costs can add up quickly for larger teams or businesses planning to rely heavily on AI-powered customer interactions.
- **Marketing add-ons can increase your overall costs:** Freshsales Suite includes 500 marketing contacts per plan, with additional contacts available starting at $100 per 5,000 contacts per month. Conversion rate optimization tools are also sold separately, so marketing-heavy organizations may end up paying more than the base subscription price.

## Onboarding and Implementation

We found Freshsales relatively easy to get up and running thanks to its setup guides, in-app tutorials and extensive support documentation. Businesses can start by connecting email accounts, configuring phone settings, importing customer data and assigning user roles before moving on to more advanced features like automation, reporting and AI tools. While the Growth plan is fairly straightforward to deploy, implementation timelines will vary depending on the number of users, integrations and customizations required.

Here are a few onboarding resources we liked:

- **Guided setup tools:** Freshsales includes setup checklists, feature tours and support articles that walk new users through the basics, making it easier to get the platform up and running.
- **Data migration options:** Businesses can import contacts, accounts and other records from spreadsheets or migrate data from another CRM. We like that teams can start with the basics and expand their setup over time instead of configuring every feature on day one.
- **Workflow and customization support:** Freshsales makes it relatively easy to configure pipelines, user permissions, automation rules and sales processes to match the way your team works.
- **Multiple support channels:** Freshsales offers phone, email, chat and ticket-based support, giving users several ways to get help during implementation and beyond.
- **Optional onboarding packages:** Businesses that want more hands-on assistance can choose from several onboarding packages, including Basic, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Enterprise options. These services range from complimentary product guidance sessions to customized onboarding engagements for larger organizations.

TipBottom line

If you're [switching CRM systems](https://www.business.com/articles/switching-crm-software/), start by migrating your core customer data and sales processes before recreating advanced automations and custom workflows. This can help your team get comfortable with the platform while reducing implementation headaches.

## Customer Support

We found Freshsales’ support resources easy to access and navigate. Freshworks provides support through live chat, email, phone and support tickets, and the company says support agents are available for real-time chat assistance 24 hours a day on weekdays. During our testing, we found the in-app chat easy to access and were connected with a support representative quickly.

Support resources include the following:

- **Live chat support:** We appreciated how easy it was to launch a chat directly from the platform. Unlike some CRM providers that route users through multiple [AI chatbot](https://www.business.com/articles/chabots-practical-ai/) prompts before offering human assistance, we were connected with a support representative quickly during our testing.
- **Extensive knowledge base:** Freshworks maintains a large support library covering everything from initial setup and user management to contact scoring, integrations, sales sequences and branded documents. We liked that much of the documentation is organized by feature area, making it easier to find answers to specific questions.
- **Multiple support channels:** In addition to live chat, users can contact support by phone, email or support ticket. Businesses can also request product demos, contact sales representatives and access product-specific resources through the Freshworks website.
- **Premium support options:** Businesses that need additional assistance can purchase Advantage or Premium support plans. These plans include benefits such as faster response times, access to specialized support teams, technical account management and proactive technical reviews.

## Limitations

Freshsales delivers an impressive mix of CRM, communication, automation and AI capabilities. However, we identified a few drawbacks businesses should consider before choosing the platform.

- **Advanced features require higher-tier plans:** Freshsales’ $9-per-user Growth plan covers the basics, but many of the platform’s most valuable sales tools — including contact scoring, deal insights, sales sequences, territory management and forecasting capabilities — require a Pro or Enterprise subscription. Businesses should review the feature breakdown carefully to ensure the plan they choose includes the functionality they need.
- **No free CRM plan:** Freshworks no longer offers a free version of Freshsales, meaning businesses must move to a paid subscription once the 21-day trial ends. While the platform remains competitively priced, startups and very small businesses looking for a permanently free CRM may prefer alternatives like Zoho CRM. Read our [Zoho CRM review](https://www.business.com/reviews/zoho-crm/) to learn more about its free plan and low-cost options.
- **The marketplace isn’t as big as some competitors’:** Freshsales integrates with many popular business applications and benefits from a growing marketplace of integrations. However, businesses with highly specialized software requirements may find broader third-party ecosystems with platforms like HubSpot and Salesforce. Read our [HubSpot CRM review](https://www.business.com/reviews/hubspot-crm/) and [Salesforce CRM review](https://www.business.com/reviews/salesforce-crm-software/) to learn more about those platforms.

## Methodology

When evaluating the [best CRM software](https://www.business.com/categories/crm-software/), we compared dozens of CRM solutions on the market. Our in-depth research included platform demonstrations, support team correspondence, hands-on trials to assess product functionality, and an analysis of each provider’s tutorials and support materials. We also took pricing into consideration.

To identify the best CRM for sales managers, we paid particular attention to contact and deal management, reporting and analytics, workflow automation, team collaboration, sales enablement tools, communication features, AI capabilities and available integrations. We also considered ease of use, implementation requirements and overall value. Our goal was to identify the CRM platforms best equipped to help sales managers monitor performance, streamline workflows and support their teams. Our product review process was designed to help your business have a [successful CRM](https://www.business.com/articles/small-business-crm-success/) implementation process with the right solution.

## Freshsales FAQs

### Is Freshworks the same as Freshsales?

Open accordion

No. Freshsales is Freshworks' CRM platform, while Freshworks is the company that offers a broader portfolio of business software. In addition to Freshsales, Freshworks offers products for customer support, IT service management, marketing automation and customer messaging. Businesses that want sales and marketing tools in a single platform can also choose Freshsales Suite, which combines CRM and marketing functionality.

### Is Freshsales free?

Open accordion

No. Freshsales no longer advertises a free CRM plan. The entry-level Growth plan starts at $9 per user per month when billed annually. However, Freshworks offers a 21-day free trial with access to Enterprise-level features, and no credit card is required to get started. (Freshworks does offer a free version of Freshmarketer, its marketing automation platform, but that is separate from Freshsales.)

## Bottom Line

We recommend Freshsales for …

- Sales managers who want strong automation, reporting and AI-powered sales insights.
- Sales teams that regularly communicate with customers via phone, chat, SMS, email and social media.
- Businesses that want an affordable CRM today and the option to expand into marketing automation with Freshsales Suite later.

We _don’t_ recommend Freshsales for …

- Very small teams looking for a permanently free CRM plan.
- Businesses that want all advanced reporting, forecasting and AI capabilities included in an entry-level plan.
- Organizations that prefer a simpler CRM with fewer features and less setup complexity.
